title: Project: Shiba Modpack
description: This contains everything you need to play on the Project: Shiba server! Join us for our 1.21 Pixelmon experience!
body:
Welcome to our Modpack page!

This pack is a 1.21.1 Pixelmon pack bundled with everything you need to play on Project: Shiba! We're a friendly community with an emphesis on growing our server with content!

Stuff to look forward to on our server
- Fully custom Guilds system! Complete Guild Missions with your friends to upgrade your guild, claim more space, increase the size of your Guild PC, Storage and more!
- Falling Stars & Meteor Showers - Watch out for falling stars and meteor showers at night, you might just notice something emerging from where they land!
- Dex-based progression - Unlock new features as you catch them all!
- Dynamax Adventures - Complete dynamax adventures with parties of up to 4 to work towards catching legendaries!
- Battletower - Do you think you have what it takes to ascend the tower?
- And so much more!

We look forward to seeing you on our server!
